metadata.description: Sample plugins and mods for Claude Code, shared as-is.

plugins.name: turn-receipt
plugins.description: After each turn, it displays the turn's tokens and cost in US dollars, its subagents' share, and the session's running total. Commands: `/receipt` shows and saves the usage for this session, `/receipt-total <N>` sums the kept sessions over the last <N|14> days, `/receipt-month` shows a month's tally, `/receipt-clear` clears the per session turn data, but it keeps the aggregate of usage per month.
